LightningComponentBundle.description: B2B / B2C - Horizontal multi-phase timeline (e.g. customer journey / project steps). Phases are JSON-configured with labels, target dates and done flags. A vertical "Today" marker shows current position.

property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'. Controls card title and the default phases when Phases JSON is empty.

property.name: scope
property.label: Default phases scope
property.description: Seeds the default phases depending on where the component is used. 'record' = customer / deal cycle (Prospection → Découverte → Démo → Proposition → Closing). 'home' = global fiscal milestones (Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 kick-off / ramp-up / expansion / year-end). Override with Phases JSON below to customise fully.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card title (override)
property.description: Leave empty for the language default ('Parcours' / 'Journey').

property.name: phasesJson
property.label: Phases - JSON array (override)
property.description: Array of objects. Each item: { label, date (YYYY-MM-DD), done (boolean) }. Leave empty for the scope + language default.

property.name: hideTodayMarker
property.label: Hide 'Today' marker
property.description: Off by default - the vertical dotted line showing today's position is displayed.
